from.description: The step koan.json recorded before the run; 0 at schema 1.

to.description: This binary's latest step, which koan.json now records (with dry_run, would record).

name.description: The step's name in the design spec's table, e.g. tree-marker.

applied.description: The steps after from, up to to; empty when none was pending, even if files a merge brought in were converted.

changed.description: Whether any file was written (with dry_run, would be).

metadata_converted.description: Whether koan.json's format was converted (with dry_run, would be). Recording a new step alone doesn't count.

state_written.description: Whether the state file was written, to take the last_id an older koan.json held (with dry_run, would be).

tasks_converted.description: How many task files were converted (with dry_run, would be).

detail.description: Human-readable: which rule it breaks, its own format's or, after conversion, this binary's.

unconverted.description: Task files in an older format that no step could convert, left as they are; the first 20.

unconverted_count.description: How many there are, including any not listed.
